I came to LuxeSmile for my first teeth whitening treatment. I arrived to my 6 PM appointment at 5:55 PM. I was called to the back at 6:25 PM. The room is very nice and serene. I was treated by Ngam, who was the sweetest woman ever! She told me my teeth were pretty white naturally, and I didn’t really need to have them whitened. She did two 20 minute intervals of whitening. She wiped my teeth in between the sessions and reapplied the gel. I was given protective eye glasses/ goggles and a blanket to make me more comfortable. The process was extremely fast and easy- I was done at 7:20 PM and this included me rinsing my mouth and taking photos/videos. Upon doing my research, I learned that my whitening transformation was not going to be as dramatic- which was consistent with my results. I didn’t notice a huge difference, but was still satisfied with my experience. If I’m ever back in Phuket, I will definitely visit LuxeSmile for another round.
Price: $2000 Thai Baht
Thank you Ngam💕
